rules.gene_order: Blocks from observed reference cells only: a gene is a type marker when its pooled type average exceeds the next type by >= 0.5 log1p CP10k and >= 20% of that type's cells detect it; IFN-alpha = measured HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE members (takes precedence); Shared = detected in >= 50% of every type; markers sorted by specificity, other blocks by pooled expression.
rules.shown_cells: Per type, the lowest tracked index whose frozen endpoint scANVI label is that type; fixed before viewing.
rules.gauge: On the type-marker genes: projection of (cell - centre of the 5 observed type averages) onto (type average - centre), scaled so 0 = centre and 1 = the median observed cell of that type.
rules.settle_step: First step from which the endpoint's top type stays on top with a gauge score >= 0.5 until the end.
rules.similarity: Cosine to the pooled observed average of the cell's endpoint type over all 2,980 genes; band = observed cells of that type (p10-p90).
rules.noisy_state: Decoded noisy diffusion state x_t: clip((value+1)/2,0,1)*8 where analog support > 0, expm1, panel CP10k, log1p. Early frames are not biological counts.
rules.prediction: Model's clean-expression prediction x0-hat at each step, same normalization; the last frame repeats the prediction at t=1/steps.
